overview: Host Terry Carter welcomed Medford Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn for a community discussion on city initiatives and family life, followed by a musical and spoken-word performance by guest artist Donna McElroy and announcements regarding community center programs.

items.title: Opening Poetry and Conversation with Mayor Lungo-Koehn
items.summary: Terry Carter shared an opening poem and interviewed Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn about balancing her re-election campaign with family life, city administrative priorities, park renovations, emergency planning, and arts initiatives.

items.title: West Medford Community Center Announcements
items.summary: Terry Carter announced upcoming events, including senior lunches, an Oldies but Goodies dance, a Brookline Bank financial planning seminar, the Black Vendors Fair, and Betty Houck's talk and play presentation.

items.title: Musical and Spoken-Word Performance by Donna McElroy
items.summary: Donna McElroy reflected on her career and history with Fisk University, performed several musical selections including spirituals and jazz standards, and recited her original poem 'Peanuts and Poetry'.

items.title: Closing Announcements and Adjournment
items.summary: Terry Carter shared updates on a $20,000 Mass Humanities grant to commemorate local Black veterans, promoted the completed brick fundraiser and next day's pumpkin smash, and closed the event.
